title: CAR-004 Policy Control Registry
description: New, standalone, additive contract for the closed-at-three AC-2.17 policy control set: the unpinned control, the adaptive control, and the orchestration-changing control. It edits, re-versions, and removes nothing in the frozen CAR-003 set (FR-005). Every reference into that set is a data-level {id, digest} binding under #/$defs/binding, never a cross-document $ref (FR-004), so the repository validator resolves nothing outside this document's own #/$defs/ (SC-017). Field-level rules and their requirement mapping live in the CAR-004 data model.

registry_digest.description: FR-002c: the registry's own content address, over the whole document with this member removed from the preimage. Control-level addresses alone would leave the closed control array, the shared smoke bounds, and the binding set outside any address.

frozen_at.description: FR-002b: a Z-suffixed UTC instant, inside the preimage, so a timestamp-only re-issue moves the address instead of silently re-using one identity.

controls.description: FR-001 and SC-001: exactly three controls, one per control_kind. A fourth entry is refused, including a justified high-effort arm.

smoke_bounds.description: FR-030: registry-level and shared by all three controls, hash-relevant to this document and to no control's identity, so re-freezing the bounds never re-identifies a comparator.

car_003_bindings.description: FR-004 and FR-005a: every frozen CAR-003 contract this document references, by stable $id and by the SHA-256 of its committed bytes. The recorded digest is recomputed on load and fails closed on a mismatch.

binding.description: FR-004 and research D2: the CAR-003 binding shape restated locally. No $ref crosses a document boundary and no $id outside car-004/ is dereferenced.

control.description: FR-003 and FR-018: the common control envelope. control_kind selects exactly one specialization object through the allOf/if/then below, following the if/then precedent the frozen experiment-policy contract already sets.

control_digest.description: FR-002 and SC-002: record_digest over this control with this member removed. Altering any hash-relevant field yields a new control version; there is no in-place edit path.

evidence_requirements.description: FR-003: the evidence row kinds a valid run must produce.

attribution_level.description: FR-018: a control is a policy, so every observation is attributed to the policy and never to a single agent's route.

executionContract.description: FR-003: what the control sets at dispatch time, the signals it reads back, and the two replay-provable bounds it runs under.

dispatch_parameters.description: FR-003: an enumerated member set rather than an open map, so 'altering any hash-relevant field' stays decidable. A control declares only the subset it actually sets.

observed_signals.description: FR-008 and FR-009: every member must resolve to a member the frozen CAR-003 execution-trace or score-bundle contract already publishes as stable. No new telemetry is coined.

retry_bounds.description: FR-014 and FR-014a: max_retries beside the FR-014a scope and breach outcome. Exhausting retries means at least one attempt failed, the one outcome the bound execution trace can evidence.

cancellation_bounds.description: FR-014 and FR-014a: max_duration_ms beside the FR-014a scope and breach outcome. The breach action is a cancellation the harness itself performs.

boundScopeAndBreach.description: FR-014a: both bound objects carry the same scope and breach members beside their own ceiling, and both are hash-relevant. Exactly one ceiling is present, selected by the enclosing bound.

counted_over.description: FR-014a.1 and FR-014a.2: per_objective on the unpinned and adaptive controls, spanning every attempt and every route the policy occupies inside that objective, so an escalation resets neither counter. per_unit on the orchestration-changing control, matching the FR-016 additive aggregation so a run cannot stay inside its bounds by distributing retries or elapsed time across children.

on_breach.description: FR-014a.3 and FR-014a.4: the frozen candidate-plane pairing, not a chosen one. abandoned and budget_exhausted stay reserved and are not representable on the bound trace; timed_out stays reserved for a platform-side timeout the harness did not request.

unpinnedControl.description: FR-006 and FR-007: exactly one arm, riding the parent session already pinned by the Claude-side environment_contract object of the frozen experiment-assignment contract. A different pin produces a different control_digest and therefore a new control version, never an in-place edit and never a second concurrent arm.

adaptiveControl.description: FR-008 through FR-015a: the total response maps over the three frozen enums, the ordered escalation ladder, and the clean-pass streak accounting. The maps are transcribed here as closed enumerations; the validator revalidates them set-equal against the frozen score-bundle contract on every load and fails closed on a membership change.

candidate_freeze_id.description: FR-011a.1: exactly one successor-capability freeze is bound.

escalation_ladder.description: FR-011, FR-011a, FR-011b: an ordered permutation of the bound freeze's admitted_tuples, by candidate_route_id. Array order is inside the preimage, so reordering the ladder yields a new adaptive-control address rather than an in-place edit. Rank is array position only.

escalation_ladder_rationales.description: FR-011a.4: one entry per cross-model step.

de_escalation_clean_pass_threshold.description: FR-012: N = 3. It lives on the control, not in the comparison contract.

terminal_state_response.description: FR-010: total and single-valued over the frozen six-member terminal-state enum.

failure_plane_response.description: FR-010: total and single-valued over the frozen twelve-member failure-plane enum.

failure_code_response.description: FR-010 and FR-015: total and single-valued over the frozen thirty-six-member failure-code enum, service_reroute included.

signal_precedence.description: FR-010b: the ordered array over the closed source set, covering every source FR-008 admits. The first source whose value is not the frozen none sentinel decides. Terminal state is always valued and is therefore ranked last, so no lower-ranked source is unreachable.

retry_count_response.description: FR-008 and FR-010b: the mapped response and rank for the retry-count source named in signal_precedence.

budget_triggers.description: FR-008 and FR-010b: ordered; the mapped response applies once the declared direction and threshold are met, which is what gives the budget-threshold source a response and a rank.

clean_pass_definition.description: FR-012 and FR-012a.1: completed, failure code none, zero retries, and no declared budget trigger met. The trigger, not a breach.

clean_pass_accounting.description: FR-012a: the five streak rules, declared rather than inferred. The non-scorable exclusion outranks the reset-on-non-clean rule, so a non-scorable objective is neither a clean pass nor a streak-breaking one.

ladderRationale.description: FR-011a.4: every step whose model differs from its predecessor's carries a non-empty rationale.

budgetTrigger.description: FR-008: member is drawn from the frozen budget field names the CAR-003 experiment-policy contract publishes. No budget field is coined here.

orchestrationChangingControl.description: FR-016 through FR-017a: additive aggregation over the parent-plus-children unit, with the terminal state folded by severity and acceptance decided by the parent objective's oracle rather than folded.

unrecorded_quantity_disposition.description: FR-016e.5: a unit member with no cache diagnostic makes that aggregate not computable, so the bound it feeds is recorded unobserved. Never passed, never zero.

terminal_state_severity.description: FR-016a: the ordered severity fold, validated set-equal rather than order-equal to the frozen terminal-state enum. The order is aggregation-only and is never read by the comparison contract.

acceptance_rule.description: FR-016b: never summed, averaged, minimized, or maximized.

acceptance_floor_on_non_completed.description: FR-016b: matches the frozen candidate-failure acceptance constant.

topologyDescriptor.description: FR-017 and FR-017a: exactly three members, restated in full so 'altering any hash-relevant field' is decidable over an enumerated member set.

fan_out.description: FR-017a: a declared ceiling on automatically spawned children, never an exact count. A run spawning fewer children, zero included, still conforms; a run spawning more is refused rather than aggregated.

childShape.description: FR-016d.1 and FR-031a.5: both members are hash-relevant. A topology admitting a member that could spawn a further node outside the CAR-004 harness is not freezable here, because its membership would not be decidable from the record.

wall_time_window.description: FR-031a.5: every unit member's recorded wall time is its full elapsed window, dispatch to completion. The frozen trace declares wall_time_ms as a bare nullable integer with no such semantics, and the parallel inequality is only sound on this reading.

aggregationRule.description: FR-016, FR-016a, FR-016b: total over all eight Pareto dimensions, none omitted.

rawTokenAggregation.description: FR-016e.1 and FR-016e.2: the frozen four-member raw token vector, deliberately not the eight-dimension Pareto vector. reasoning_output_tokens is summed and reported but is not a Pareto dimension, carries no ceiling, and is not an input to the raw-token identity.

cacheAggregation.description: FR-016e.3 and FR-016e.4: diagnostic-only. Aggregating these promotes nothing — neither becomes a Pareto dimension, neither enters the raw-token identity, and neither is constrained against max_input_tokens. Keys match the ceilings that bound them exactly.

smokeBounds.description: FR-030, FR-030a, FR-030b, FR-030c: the closed bound set for the three bounded operator smokes, counted over the parent-plus-children unit. authentication_mode and scored are deliberately NOT members: both are properties of a produced smoke record rather than declared bounds, and a const subscription bound would restate operator intent and make a refused api_key record unrepresentable.

max_duration_seconds.description: FR-030b: elapsed wall clock over the unit, not the additive duration_ms the Pareto rule sums.

max_cached_input_tokens.description: FR-030a: coined by CAR-004 because the frozen budget carries no ceiling for that raw-token member.

raw_token_ceiling.description: FR-030a: the right-hand side of the machine-checked identity max_input_tokens + max_cached_input_tokens + max_output_tokens == raw_token_ceiling. The three summands are the ceilings on the three bounded members of the frozen raw token vector; an identity admitting either cache diagnostic is refused.

max_cache_read_tokens.description: FR-016e.4 and FR-030a: bounds the cache-read diagnostic, which stays outside the raw-token identity and is never checked against max_input_tokens.

max_cache_write_tokens_by_ttl_class.description: FR-030a: diagnostic-only, keyed over the frozen closed TTL class space, and outside the raw-token identity.

unitAndDirection.description: FR-030a and FR-034.6: every numeric in smoke_bounds carries its unit and its comparison direction, following the frozen guardrail-method precedent, so the twin-handoff record derives category 6 from these committed bytes rather than transcribing a bare integer. All ten bounds are ceilings on costs, so higher is worse.
